name: PC-cillin 雲端版 (Trend Micro Maximum Security)

summary.en: Trend Micro supports Windows 11 on Arm in PC-cillin Cloud (Maximum Security). Linaro lists it as native, verified by NVIDIA.
summary.zh-TW: 趨勢科技的 PC-cillin 雲端版支援 Windows 11 on ARM。Linaro 目錄記錄為原生版本，NVIDIA 也驗證過。

caveats.en: Only PC-cillin Cloud has an Arm installer, and you download it after signing in to a Trend Micro account. Performance optimization, the security settings check and Do Not Disturb mode are not available on Arm.
caveats.zh-TW: 只有 PC-cillin 雲端版有 Arm 安裝檔，要先註冊趨勢科技會員才能下載。效能最佳化、安全設定檢查和無干擾模式在 Arm 上無法使用。

evidence.title: PC-cillin 防毒軟體：Windows 安裝需求（ARM 架構僅雲端版支援）
PC-cillin 產品頁：支援 Windows 11 on ARM，部分功能不支援
Works on WoA: Trend Micro Maximum Security, native, verified by NVIDIA
